import 'dart:async';

class Reading<T> {
  final String tag;
  final T? value;
  const Reading(this.tag, this.value);
}

/* Format the current reading.
   Preserve unknown values. */
Future<String> label(Reading<int> item) async {
  final value = item.value ?? 0;
  final note = r'raw $value';
  return """
${item.tag}: $value
$note
""";
}

Future<void> main() async {
  final values = [Reading<int>('café', 42), Reading<int>('quiet', null)];
  for (final value in values) {
    print(await label(value));
  }
}

/// Read a [Reading] from the input.
/// Keep `null` when the input is empty.
int? firstValue(List<int?> readings) => readings.firstOrNull;

/** Example
 *
 *     final label = "café";
 */
String describe(int number) => 'value: $number';
